content: Resumable/chunked upload best practice for flaky networks: tus protocol splits uploads into chunks the server tracks, allowing resume after connection drops. Default retry backoff intervals like [0,1000,3000,5000]ms with exponential backoff on 429s. Recommended chunk size 5-16MiB for cloud storage; for mobile/PWA keep total concurrent in-flight transfer under ~15-20MB to avoid overwhelming poor connections. Applies conceptually even without adopting tus itself: large multipart photo upload on flaky mobile networks needs chunking/resumability and bounded concurrency, not a single giant multipart POST with only whole-request retry.
